details.releaseNotesExcerpt: ## Overview This release adds the LiquidAI LFM3 family (text, vision, audio and omni) together with a new experimental streaming-audio API in `mtmd`, and wires realtime audio in and out of the server through the new `/v1/realtime` and `/tts` endpoints. A batch of new architectures landed: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, SenseNova U1, Beam, Kolibri-1, Flint, Muse Spark, Granite Switch Decision, plus decision/embedding models from LiquidAI, Baidu and NVIDIA. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> common, mtmd: bound control vector layer indices and M-RoPE position loops (#31336) * common: bound control vector layer indices by the model layer count A direction tensor layer index is parsed from the tensor name with no upper bound, and the buffer size and write offset are computed in int. A large index overflows both, so the accumulation writes before the start of the buffer. Pass the model layer count to the loader, reject indices above it like the existing zero index check, and compute the sizes in size_t. * mtmd: fill M-RoPE positions by whole merge tiles The position loops of the Qwen-VL, GLM, PaddleOCR and Qwen2.5-VL encoders hardcode a 2x2 merge inside a stride of n_merge, so a patch grid that is not a multiple of the merge writes past the positions buffer. Iterate over whole merge tiles with n_merge inner steps, which bounds the writes by the patch count and gives the same positions on aligned grids. Slice the input with process_view_input_new, as the other translators do. Give it the same treatment the Q8_0 kernel got in #30775: a flat sycl::range<1> launch with four qs bytes (8 outputs) per work-item inside one 32-element block and two vec<dst_t,4> stores. Same float math and rounding as the scalar kernel; output is bit-identical. The existing k % QK4_0 == 0 assert guarantees whole 32-element blocks, so the k/8 launch covers every row exactly. The now-unreferenced scalar reorder kernel is removed.
